summary: The opening level only asks for the two gathering huts and a small log stockpile, so the fastest finish is to build both huts immediately next to the trees and let the villagers stock logs.

build_order.note: First objective; place it next to bushes so foragers keep the five adults fed.
Second objective; the six logs it stocks complete the third.

pitfalls: The optional objective is to recycle the Canoe; it is easy to forget once the main objectives are done.
source: Drafted from the stored objectives and the 24 October menu observation; not a timed playthrough.
